style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for pack and info screens, soft ice-blue #A8DCE6 for the hero, mist-grey #F2F6F7 panels for feature and comparison screens, dark matte panelled wall #2F3437 for the low-key night screen

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool ice-blue smart-home appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, soft ice-blue #A8DCE6, ink-teal text #23474F and one champagne accent #C8A57B; cool tone throughout; soft diffused studio lighting with a cool key from the upper front-left, a gentle rim along the top edge and soft contact shadows; consistent matte wall surface and fine brushed-metal accent language on every screen; modern geometric sans-serif headline type; consistent thin-line rounded icon style in #23474F; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and stable product scale with the champagne trim line, the front display area and the full-width air guide plate in the same position on every screen; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no decorative clutter.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and stable product scale; the champagne trim line, the front display area and the full-width air guide plate keep the same position and proportion on every screen; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: matte mist-grey wall #F2F6F7, light brushed-grey panel #E4E8EA, dark wood-panel wall #3A3F42
